summary: Garmin Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on June 5, 2026. Shareholders approved the annual report, appropriation of earnings, a $4.20 per share cash dividend payable in four installments, discharge of directors and management, re-election of six directors, and re-election of the Executive Chairman. All proposals passed with routine vote tallies. This is a standard governance update with no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review.
